It's resort-ready by design: linen-look fabric photographs well in bright daylight, the rust-and-ivory palette flatters every skin tone, and the cuts run breezy enough for boardwalks, seaside dinners, and long-table lunches. Adult sizing follows Asian sizing and tends to run small — sizing up one from your usual US/EU size is recommended. White pants, shorts, hats, sunglasses, shoes, bags, and accessories shown in product photos are styling only and not included.

Measurements are garment measurements in centimeters; chest is the full chest circumference, and child heights are the suggested wearer height. Hip and waist measurements are unavailable, and the chart gives no weight guidance, so check child height first and compare the chest, sleeve, and garment-length measurements with a sweater that fits well. Hand measuring can vary by 1-3 cm.

Note on larger kid sizes: the size chart lists measurements through Child 9–10 Years (≈150 cm). For Child 10–12, 11–12, 12–14, and 13–14, we recommend the next size up from the largest size in the chart — and we're happy to swap or refund if the fit isn't right.

The size chart shows garment length, chest, shoulder, sleeve, recommended height, and recommended weight. Weight ranges were converted from jin to kilograms.
